conditions.passMeaning: Valid instrumented run, not a 60 FPS or presentation acceptance assertion
conditions.coverage: Plain replay covers walking only; events replay adds spins at original route orientation boundaries at 1x. Neither profile crosses a seam, so flip transitions and negative tiles require separate coverage. Follow starts true by default; actual production manual spin may turn it off on completion.
conditions.driver: Trusted browser inputs; unchanged production frame()/scheduler/update/render/HUD; no external RAF sampler
conditions.coldDefinition: First input after synthetic fixture has rendered and naturally idled; not process/shader initialization
conditions.method: Continuous intervals require previous production frame to have scheduled continuation. Normal idle gaps are retained separately. CPU is synchronous production frame() work including HUD; input handler CPU is outside it. Input-to-frame-end is not presentation latency. Event Timing is quantized/thresholded and is not exact present latency.
conditions.traceParser: python3 tests/summarize-render-trace.py <trace>.json.gz; RAF/JSAnimation counters may overlap; do not sum

surfaceBefore.screenMetricsCaveat: Playwright may emulate window.screen; native outer bounds and visibility are audited separately. These checks do not prove absence of OS occlusion or physical scanout of every pixel.
